# اِنْطَرَحْتِ (inṭaraḥti) /in.tˤa.raħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْطَرَحَ (inṭaraḥa)
# اِنْطَرَحَتْ (inṭaraḥat) /in.tˤa.ra.ħat/: third-pe
